en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a 19th‑century European spa town nestled in a steep, wooded valley. Dense rows of multi‑storey historicist townhouses and grand hotels line the hillside. In the foreground is a long, ornate colonnade with arches and a pavilion roof, crowded with people, suggesting a promenade over thermal springs. A forested hill rises directly behind the town, with more villas and hotels scattered higher up the slope.
